爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD043 浅香萌里Asaka Moeri-铃响的瞬间
她指尖刚碰到颈间银铃，冰凉触感窜上锁骨。
心跳忽然乱了拍，耳尖烫得发麻，黑蕾丝袖口滑落一寸。
她慌忙按住，却把铃按得轻轻一响。
那一声正好落进他耳里，她脸红着抬眼，被轻轻拢进怀里，铃再没乱响。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD043 Asaka Moeri-The Moment the Bell Ringed
Her fingertips had just touched the silver bell around her neck when the cool sensation shot up her collarbone.
Her heart suddenly pounded, her ears burned, and her black lace sleeve slipped down an inch.
She hurriedly pressed it down, but only managed a soft ring.
That sound reached his ears perfectly. She blushed and looked up, only to be gently pulled into his embrace. The bell fell silent.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
